items.name: token-saver
items.what: CLI proxy that filters command output to save tokens: wraps build, test, git, file listing and any shell command the user runs.
items.impact: Always on; every code command and file output becomes shorter.
items.activation: Install the hook once; it runs on every command.

items.name: graph-index
items.what: Index a code repository into a knowledge graph so an agent can ask structural questions: callers, dependencies, modules.
items.impact: Faster code navigation in large repositories.
items.activation: When exploring or answering structural questions about a repository.

items.name: model-gateway
items.what: Gateway that routes agent prompts to other model providers when the usage limit or quota is reached.
items.impact: Keeps sessions running after the weekly limit by switching providers.
items.activation: When the quota or usage limit runs out.
